# Dense 2-parameter [2,12] family: mechanism-A locus on the M(12) halving surface.
# Surface: N(k,r,z)=0 where N = numerator of Q4(k), Q4 = f5/(X - a/z) residual quartic,
# f5 = odd quintic model of y^2+(x-r)(T+1)y = a x^2 T(T+1), T = a x^2-x+r, a=(1-z^2)/(4(r+1)).
# f5 always has the rational root rho0 = a/z (disc(T+1)=z^2); a second rational root k gives
# a second rational 2-torsion class T1; marked D has order 12 => torsion contains [2,12].
